Headline: #95 95th Temporary Reroute at 95th/Prospect

Headline: Blue Line Service Running with Delays
ShortDescription: UPDATE: Blue Line trains are running with delays near Clinton due to a police investigation.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Blue Line trains are running with delays near Clinton due to a police investigation.

As a result, trains are operating only between O'Hare to Lasalle and Forest Park to Western-cn at this time.

Shuttles buses have been requested from Lasalle to Western-cn providing connecting service through the affected area in both directions.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#56 Milwaukee

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
